meta.source: Computed by npm run build:data from data/serial-formats.json and data/lifespans.json with assets/js/formulas.js
meta.notes: Default result and worked example are computed as of 2026-11-13 (site.json dateVerified). The live calculator uses the visitor's date.

default.headline: About 7.1 years old (built October 2019)
default.explain: That is about 59% of the 12-year typical life for this type (gas tank), adjusted for your answers. Estimated remaining life: 1.9 to 6.9 years. (Example serial, as of 2026-11-13; type yours.)
default.formula:
Built: October 2019 (Rheem / Ruud code: week 43, year 2019)
Age = today − October 2019 = 7.1 years
Expected life (gas tank) = 10–15 years, typical 13; adjustments: -1 for no yearly flush
Adjusted life = 9–14, typical 12 years (never below 5)
Share used = 7.1 ÷ 12 = 59%
default.sources: Rheem / Ruud date code: Rheem/Ruud lookup, InspectApedia (third party), Energy Trust of Oregon. Lifespan: DOE 2024 water heater rule and DOE FEMP. Hardness, flushing and anode adjustments are our editorial assumptions. See the decoder checked against Rheem/Ruud, Bradford White, A. O. Smith and CPSC.

summaryRows.rule: older tags: 1 letter, then month (2 digits), year (2 digits) and a plant letter; or older tags: 2 to 4 letters, then month (2 digits) and year (2 digits); or plant letter, then week (2 digits) and year (2 digits); or older all-digit serials: month (2 digits), then year (2 digits)
summaryRows.example: R0804B***** → August 2004 (older tags, often printed as R 0804B…); RH0806B***** → August 2006 (Rheemglas Fury tag RH 0806B17262); Q4319***** → week 43 of 2019 (Rheem/Ruud lookup: October 18, 2019); 0794****** → July 1994

summaryRows.rule: since 2008: year (2 digits), week (2 digits), then a letter; since October 2016 the letter is gone and nine digits follow (YYWW + 9 digits); or before 2008: factory letter, month letter, then year (2 digits); or before 2008: month letter, year (2 digits), then a letter
summaryRows.example: 2215123456789 → 2022, week 15 (all digits since October 2016; A. O. Smith prints it as 1601 123 456 789); 0805A****** → 2008, week 5; *H06****** → August 2006; L07A****** → November 2007
DF******* → June 1967, 1987, 2007 or 2027 (latest not in the future)

summaryRows.rule: since 2008: year (2 digits), then week (2 digits); or before 2008: month letter, then year (2 digits); or before mid-2004: factory letter, month letter, then year (2 digits)
summaryRows.example: 0904******* → 2009, week 4 (Energy Trust labels this example April 2009, which does not match its own year-week rule; we follow the rule); C05******* → March 2005; AF04A****** → June 2004
9746****** → 1997, week 46 (Energy Trust); 1115…–1631… = April 2011 to August 2016 (CPSC recall range)
9746****** → 1997, week 46 (Energy Trust); 1115…–1631… = April 2011 to August 2016 (CPSC recall range)
